title: Workplace injury reporting

# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Record the date and time the accident occurred.
3. Note down the names, job titles and contact information of everyone involved (including witnesses).
4. Describe the exact location of the accident (building, floor, room, etc.).
5. Write a clear, concise and factual account of what happened leading up to, during and immediately after the accident. Include as much detail as possible.
6. Attach or include any relevant photos or sketches of the accident scene.
7. Make a note of any immediate emergency action taken (call to emergency services, application of first aid, etc.)
8. Record injuries sustained by the involved parties and immediate medical treatment given.
9. Include any immediate corrective action taken to prevent further injury or damage.
10. Mention if any equipment, machinery or processes were involved in the accident.
11. Note if any hazardous substances were involved and how they were contained/controlled.
12. Summarize the known or suspected cause(s)
